newsitem.title: USA: BGE Calvert Cliffs nuke seen on line Sun..
newsitem.headline: BGE Calvert Cliffs nuke seen on line Sun..

text.p: Baltimore Gas and Electric Co said its 850 megawatt (MW) Calvert Cliffs 1 nuclear power station was expected to resume electricity output late Sunday following a shutdown Thursday for repairs.
"Barring any unforeseen problems it should begin producing electricity late Sunday," a company spokesman said Friday.
The unit, in Lusby, Md., was shut late Thursday to repair a leak in the reactor coolant system.

The leak, discovered in a fitting on a 3/4-inch diameter pipe, had been repaired as of early Friday, the spokesman said. The company continued to keep the unit out of service to investigate the potential for similar leaks on nearby pipes, he said.
The facility's adjacent unit 2 was operating at 93 percent of its 850 MW rated capacity during testing of the unit's moderator temperature coefficient.
